filename: T2 - Mixed subependymoma and ependymoma posterior fossa , ventricle 008.jpg
description:
Posterior fossa heterogenous mass is located within the fourth ventricle and appears to arise from the posterior aspect of the medulla.

The mass has speckled calcifications and heterogeneously enhances.
